name: Todoroki Yuu
source:
"I'm... no good" 

A former gang leader with a dark past. He's currently living away from human settlements. He won't open his heart. He's liked by spirits, and can manipulate vegetation. 

Battle quote - "It's already been decided... you can't run anymore."

[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
